'''Masha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] supply officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with Republic forces under [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Supply Officer Masha appears as the reputation vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
